children: Samsung Electronics has decided to use TSMC’s 3-nanometer process to manufacture NVHBM base dies at Nvidia’s request, according to Korean media cited by Citrini analyst Jukan. According to Odaily, Samsung has not ruled out using its own foundry lines and is assessing whether it could produce the base dies in-house if NVHBM demand exceeds TSMC’s capacity.

title: Samsung Electronics to Use TSMC 3nm Process for NVHBM Base Dies at Nvidia's Request
